reason: The knob IS live in exp70g: c0 l.90 sets 7.0, the builder's --set block is appended after it, c2 l.80 reads it, cells 3/4 hard-set only SECONDARY_*/DUAL_SEED_*, it is not in the cell-1 guard, VALIDATOR_ENABLE=0 so the ppsweep never rewrites the output, and c7 l.696/733 uses it as the tight gate of every flow frame. The relink output replaces all ILP edges (c7 l.1967-1978) and safetail/lowrefine/divinsert do not bypass it. The PAIR still fails. (1) The DOWN arm is dead at any value. My replay of the byte-identical c7 motion_relink_edges on the exp58 visible-test nodes gives 0.053% edge churn at 6.0 on the densest clip, and only 0.03-0.09% at 3.0-6.0 on both dense clips: the 10 um relaxed pass re-matches the same pairs. So the down slot is a guaranteed 0.956 tie that says nothing about the sign, which breaks the JT two-arm method. (2) The UP arm is small and steep: 7.5 gives 0.14/0.20% churn, 8.0 gives 0.31/0.71% (+13/+73 edges), 8.5 gives 0.80/2.34%. Our own relink-stage probes give a scale for these numbers. Measured against real outputs vs exp29, relink OFF was 6-17% churn, LEARNED_BONUS 2.5 was 0.55-2.5% and gshift was 3.8-9.8%, and all three read 0.945 vs 0.947. That is 3 of 3 relink-stage changes at -0.002. 8.0 is at or below the bonus-2.5 size, so the expected read is a tie or +-0.001, and the prior leans negative. (3) The mechanism of UP is max-cardinality forcing (big = gate*1000+1): the extra edges link track ends and orphans in dense regions. Those are the same orphans that safe-div and DIVINS (steal=1) turn into divisions, so UP competes with the division channel our best gains came from. Runtime and node count are not the problem (relink ~15 s/clip, nodes change only through the short-track filter, well under 1%). It is not on the closed list, but it is the relink stage, which has read negative 3 times.
fixed_values: No valid two-arm pair exists for this knob: the down side is inert at every value down to 3.0 (<0.1% churn). The only informative variant is a single UP arm: 8.0 (0.3-0.7% edge churn on the dense visible clips, lower bound). 8.5 (0.8-2.3%) is the largest defensible value if a readable size is wanted; 9.0 (2.3-6.8%) is too big. Low priority behind knobs with a live down side.
build_line: UP: --set MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_TIGHT_UM=8.0 | DOWN: none (6.0 and even 3.0 are inert, 0.03-0.09% edge churn; do not spend a slot)
